Package in.co.rays.model

Class TimetableModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • in.co.rays.model.TimetableModel
  • public class TimetableModel
extends java.lang.Object
    The TimetableModel class handles CRUD operations and validations for the Timetable entity in the application. It interacts with the `st_timetable` table in the database using JDBC. Author: Yusuf Khan
